name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
description: Yumemizuki Mizuki is a Yumekui-Baku (dream-eating spirit) working as a clinical psychologist in Inazuma and a founding shareholder of the Aisa Bathhouse. She specializes in soothing troubled dreams and counsels those plagued by nightmares.
